options: A library can coordinate elements entering and leaving, shared layout movement, or sequences. It also adds code and concepts. Some people ask the operating system to reduce animation. Read the reduced-motion preference and remove large movement, parallax, or long transitions where possible. Keep the same information and controls available. A moving walkway should have a safe still path beside it.
